body: Tanushree Bagrodia (Director & Group CEO) on the Q3FY26 call (2026-02-10), prompted: "Our CAPEX remains to be about 2.5% to 3% of our revenue and we continue to be within that limit" Metric: Capex/revenue. Target: 2.5-3% of revenue. Deadline: 2026-03-31 (fiscal-year). Specificity: range. Status as of 2026-11-19: DELIVERED. Evidence: FY26 capex 7+6+5+12 = ~INR 30 cr = 2.6% of INR 1,170 cr (quarterly CFO disclosures). Note the band drifting up: 2.5% (May-25) -> 2.5-3% (Feb-26) -> 2.5-3.5% (May-26) -> INR ~60 cr 'over next year' (Nov-26), i.e. ~4% of FY27 revenue.
